description: This Java class defines an immutable, final class 'SessionedResponseErrorOrAck' which implements the 'SessionedJsonifiable' interface. It represents a session-scoped JSON-serializable object that does not support signal enrichment, providing methods to access its JSON content and headers, retrieve extra fields (which are empty), and get its associated session (which is absent).

classes.name: SessionedResponseErrorOrAck
classes.description: Immutable, final class representing a session-scoped JSON-serializable object that does not support signal enrichment.

methods.name: getJsonifiable
methods.description: Returns the JSON content associated with this object.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with this object.

methods.name: retrieveExtraFields
methods.description: Returns additional fields asynchronously, which are empty in this implementation.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional, indicating no associated session.
